title: Developer Utilities Module
summary: This module provides command-line tools for automating version management, Git tagging, and documentation generation/translation based on code changes, streamlining the release process.

nodes.label: Bump Package Versions
nodes.title: Update Project Package Versions
nodes.description: Automates the process of updating version strings across all project packages and prepares a dedicated Git branch and initiates a Pull Request for these version changes.

nodes.label: Manage Git Branches
nodes.title: Git Branch Operations
nodes.description: Handles the creation, checkout, and pushing of specific Git branches to the remote repository, essential for both version updates and documentation changes.

nodes.label: Create Pull Request
nodes.title: Initiate GitHub Pull Request
nodes.description: Generates and submits a new Pull Request on GitHub, facilitating code review and merging for version bumps or documentation updates.

nodes.label: Validate Package Versions
nodes.title: Check Package Version Consistency
nodes.description: Ensures that all detected project packages maintain a consistent version number, preventing discrepancies before a new release tag is created.

nodes.label: Create Git Tag & Release
nodes.title: Tag Git Repo and GitHub Release
nodes.description: Creates and pushes a new Git tag to the repository, typically on the main branch, and subsequently publishes a corresponding release on GitHub.

nodes.label: Generate Release Notes
nodes.title: Automate Release Note Creation
nodes.description: Leverages an AI language model to automatically draft comprehensive release notes for a new software version, summarizing key changes and features.

nodes.label: Update Docs for Release
nodes.title: Integrate Docs into Release Flow
nodes.description: Orchestrates the process of updating and generating documentation as an integral part of the software release cycle, including creating a dedicated PR.

nodes.label: Analyze Code Changes
nodes.title: Identify Doc Needs from Code Diff
nodes.description: Examines the differences between code branches (git diff) to intelligently determine if new or updated documentation is required based on code modifications.

nodes.label: Generate Documentation Content
nodes.title: Create/Update Docs with LLM
nodes.description: Utilizes an AI language model to automatically generate new documentation sections or update existing content based on identified code changes and requirements.

nodes.label: Translate Documentation
nodes.title: Localize Documentation Content
nodes.description: Translates the generated English documentation into multiple supported languages, ensuring broader accessibility for the project's user base.

nodes.label: Git Repository
nodes.title: Version Control System
nodes.description: The central Git repository where all source code, branches, tags, and commit history for the project are managed and stored.

nodes.label: GitHub API
nodes.title: GitHub Platform Services
nodes.description: The programmatic interface for interacting with GitHub, used for operations such as creating Pull Requests, managing releases, and fetching repository data.

nodes.label: OpenAI LLM
nodes.title: AI Language Model Service
nodes.description: An external AI language model service (e.g., OpenAI GPT) used for advanced text generation, code analysis, and translation tasks within the development workflow.

nodes.label: Package Version Files
nodes.title: Source Code Version Information
nodes.description: Files within individual project packages (e.g., `__version__.py`) that explicitly define and store the current semantic version number of each package.

nodes.label: Documentation Files
nodes.title: Project Documentation Assets
nodes.description: The collection of Markdown or MDX files that constitute the project's official documentation, stored in various languages and formats.

nodes.label: Code Changes (Git Diff)
nodes.title: Git Difference Output
nodes.description: Structured data representing the differences between two Git commits or branches, used as input for analyzing code changes and documentation needs.

groups.label: Version & Release Management
groups.title: Automated Versioning and Release
groups.description: Handles bumping package versions, managing Git branches, creating pull requests, and generating Git tags and GitHub releases with automated release notes.

groups.label: Documentation Automation
groups.title: AI-Powered Documentation Workflow
groups.description: Automates the process of generating and translating documentation content based on code changes, leveraging AI for content creation and localization.

groups.label: Code & Version Analysis
groups.title: Analysis for Development Operations
groups.description: Performs analytical tasks such as validating package version consistency and analyzing code differences to inform documentation needs and release readiness.

groups.label: Data Artifacts
groups.title: Key Data Assets
groups.description: Represents the various data files and artifacts that are read from or written to during the development utility operations, including version and documentation files.
